name: Custom Command
description: Run a command on the host as its non-admin account (PowerShell on Windows) and show its output, repeated at the interval you choose. Installed by default. The runner is built into Bosun; this package carries its permissions, settings and size.
author: Bosun

permissions.label: See Custom Command widgets
permissions.description: See the Custom Command widget and the output of its command.

permissions.label: Run commands
permissions.description: Run an arbitrary command on the host as the service account through the API, and set the command of a Custom Command widget (which runs as the non-admin account).

widgets.description: Run a command on the host as its non-admin account (PowerShell on Windows) and show its output, repeated at the interval you choose

config_schema.label: Command
config_schema.description: Runs as the non-admin shell account of the host (no sudo or Docker access) each time the widget repeats. On Windows the untouched default shows how long the machine has been up.

config_schema.label: Repeat every (seconds)
config_schema.description: How often the command runs, from 10 to 3600 seconds. The result is shared by everyone viewing the widget.

view.text: Custom Command is drawn by Bosun itself.
